reviews.t: There is a reason for duplicate brushes.
reviews.x: Duplicate size brushes are included because we ALL use multiple colors. This way you're getting true color, not a blend of 2 different colors, i.e., blue/yellow = green etc. You don't want that. Especially when you're applying a specific cream color but you used the brush already for a smoky gray...right? Same with lipsticks. No more complaints about duplicates ladies. Be grateful they have them in this amazing kit.

Wow, I freaking love this color concealer palette and the brush set. The brushes are surprisingly good quality, they don't shred at all. And the color concealers are good too. My fav colors are he green and purple for correcting purpose, the yellow to brightens, salmon color for under eyes, and a dark shade to contour. They are all very wearable though! Love this, so cheap too. Definitely recommend :)

claims.text: Many reviewers praise the brushes as soft, good quality, and effective for applying makeup without shedding or scratching.
Several reviewers complain that the brush set contains repetitive or duplicate brushes rather than a varied selection.
Multiple reviewers report the concealer arrived melted or melty.
Some reviewers were disappointed by missing, wrong, used, or poor-quality items in the set.
Several reviewers note the product arrived earlier than expected and was packaged well.
